description: DynamicTrees JSON file to define a leaf type and its properties

primitive_leaves.description: The block the leaves are made of. These will drop when sheared.

type.description: Allows for custom behavior beyond these properties. More can be added by addons.

cell_kit.description: The shape logic of the leaves.

smother.description: The maximum count of leaves a leaf block can have on top before dying

light_requirement.description: The minimum light value for the leaves not to die

fire_spread.description: The fire spread value of the block

flammability.description: The flammability value of the block

connect_any_radius.description: If true, leaves will connect to any radius instead of just 1

ageing_configuration.description: When leaves are allowed to tick and grow/decay.

can_grow_on_ground.description: If false leave will leave a gap of air with the ground.

color.description: The color of the leaves. It can be a Hex value, Int value or {@biome, @birch, @spruce}. More can be added by addons.

family.description: The family of trees the leaves can connect to. It must first be defined in the Families folder.

generate_block.description: Whether the leaves need a block to be registered

block_registry_name.description: The registry name of the block (By default it uses the name of the file + "_leaves")

scruffy_leaf_chance.description: The percentage of leaf blocks that will be skipped

scruffy_max_hydro.description: The maximum distance value that skipped leaves can have

seed_drop_chances.description: An array of 4 chances to drop leaves when harvested. Each value represents a level of fortune enchantment with 0 being no fortune.

requires_shears.description: If leaves are required to obtain the full block.
